title: Level Not Completed (Player Reached End Without Portal Trigger)
explanation: Player navigated to the end of Level01 (coordinates X=7458.2, Y=159.9) at frame(s) [12722], reaching the expected end-of-level portal destination (Portal2D at X≈7410, Y≈160). However, no 'portal_entered', 'portal_transition_started', or 'level_completed' event was dispatched, and goal.found remained false. The player remained stranded at the level exit, blocking game progression.
